Pinned verifier image: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template (sha256 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd for both): node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim tag bases, @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; apt unpinned (NOTE-level per check-dockerfiles.py, template-controlled). COPY . /tests; no solution copied. Judge tomls: tomllib parse of all five [judge] tables yields only judge='claude-code', mode='batched', timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template='prompt.md' plus mcp_servers (playwright; functional also verifier -> /tests/tools/restart_mcp.py $APP_RESTART_HELPER). No model, reasoning_effort, temperature or [judge].weight key; the 'weight =' lines are [[criterion]] weights. grep for glm/openrouter/REWARDKIT_MODEL outside task.toml finds only test.sh:63-64, which refuses to grade if REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL are empty (fail-safe, template test.sh byte-identical per diff). App launch uses env -i (test.sh:104,160) so judge credentials are not passed to the submitted app. Lessons file check: lesson 11 (judge infra crash e.g. unrecognized_model) bears on this row - no configured judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'), so live acceptance of z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx via OpenRouter and the key is NOT EXERCISED; however the block is the template-frozen value that this row requires unchanged and must not be edited, so it is not a task defect. Lesson 13 (no public URL in judge prompts) is row 25's scope, not this row. Adversarial: a broken app cannot influence this row (pure wiring); a conforming alternative cannot fail it. A plausible defect (model in judge.toml, edited base URL, real key in task.toml, allowlist missing openrouter.ai) is absent.
